headline: Eversource petition to install conduits and a concrete silo at Aspen Road and Butternut Street.
summary: Eversource asks to install two 3-inch conduits and a 36-inch silo along Butternut Street and Aspen Road. The conduits are needed to fix an existing primary cable fault.
items: Eversource petition to install two 3-inch conduits and a 36-inch concrete silo
Conduits to run from Butternut Street south to Aspen Road, then east down Aspen Road
Silo with green fiberglass cover to be placed in public way in front of 5 Aspen Road
plain_text:
Board of Public Works                                          1                                       Printed 11/16/2026 
 
 
                         BOARD OF PUBLIC WORKS       
  
                                Hearings Meeting Agenda 
   
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can be acted 
upon at the meeting of the Board of Public Works Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 3:30 PM.  
  
City Clerk  
 
Location 
At the corner of Aspen Rd. and Butternut Street. 
 
Petitions 
To install two (2) 3inch conduits and a 36-inch concrete silo. The conduit will start at the 
existing pad located on Butternut Street (2036/1) and run South towards the intersection of 
Butternut Street and Aspen Road. Eversource would then install a 36inch silo with green 
fiberglass cover to be used as a pull point and proceed East down Aspen Road, ending at an 
existing pad (2035/2). The conduits will be located in the roadway near the curb line – The silo 
to be located in public way in front of 5 Aspen Road. These conduits are needed to fix an 
existing primary cable fault. 
 1. EVERSOURCE - Butternut Street
